meta.title: Music of South Asia, other
meta.description: Indo-Caribbean music in New York, the Nanda Devi festival in Almora, and other South Asian fieldwork outside Richard K. Wolf's main research areas.

attrs.alt: A bearded man in white, wearing mirrored sunglasses, reading from a small book beneath a tree.
attrs.headline: Music of South Asia, other

content.text: Some of my field research does not fit squarely within the regional and conceptual rubrics under which I have organized this website. Examples from my audiovisual documentation of Indo-Caribbean music in New York, the Nanda Devi Festival in Almora (now in Uttarakhand state, India), and other miscellaneous South Asia-related musical activities reside in this section of the website.
